sentence: North Willow Manufacturing entered a binding deal to buy a niche software vendor.
Mallow Peak Holdings completed an acquisition of a manufacturing competitor.
North Willow Manufacturing cancelled a previously funded expansion of its testing facility.
Mallow Peak Holdings abandoned plans for additional capital investment in production lines.
North Willow Manufacturing broke ground on a new advanced materials plant.
Mallow Peak Holdings invested in additional CNC manufacturing equipment.
North Willow Manufacturing introduced an efficiency programme to lower payroll expenses.
Mallow Peak Holdings consolidated back-office functions to achieve cost savings.
North Willow Manufacturing divested its precision motors business.
Mallow Peak Holdings completed a disposal of three industrial sites.
North Willow Manufacturing disclosed annual incentive pay for its managing director.
Mallow Peak Holdings revised the equity compensation of its executives.
North Willow Manufacturing organised a community engineering workshop.
Mallow Peak Holdings launched a new corporate design handbook.
North Willow Manufacturing posted a 12 percent increase in earnings.
Mallow Peak Holdings announced lower income before tax for the quarter.
North Willow Manufacturing repurchased ordinary shares under its buyback authority.
Mallow Peak Holdings extended a programme to buy back outstanding stock.
